Good effort for Xmas service
Dec 2015 • Friends
My friends and I went to Bonjour Resto' for a Xmas dinner. The restaurant didn't take reservation so we had to come in early to get a table. It was a busy night but service was reasonably fast. However, the food was just average and wasn't hot enough. All main courses came with the same sides: salad and fries. I thought it was boring doing so. My duck breast with orange sauce was all right, but my friend's lamb fillet was rather too chewy. Lastly, the panna cotta with passion fruit sauce was a bit too sour to my taste. 

The restaurant is small and cozy. I chose a table by a window but sadly there is no view.
